job.job_description:
As a Research Engineer at LG Soft India, you will be at the forefrontof developing intelligent software solutions that power LGs next-generationdevices and platforms. You will work on scalable backend systems, AI/MLintegrations, and CI/CD pipelines to deliver high-performance, intelligentservices.
KeyResponsibilities
Buildand maintain scalable backend services using Python, Java, or Node.js.
DevelopRESTful APIs using FastAPI, for software and hardware integration.
Hands-onexperience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL)
Workwith NoSQL databases like MongoDB, including query optimization.
Managetime-series databases and optimize data handling for performance.
Writeoptimized queries, including advanced operations like CTEs, stored procedures.
Ensureefficient data handling and retrieval using SQLAlchemy and MongoDB filters inPython.
DevelopCI/CD pipelines for automated deployment and testing for services.
Optimizesystem performance for latency, scalability, and power efficiency across platforms.
Conductload testing and performance tuning to ensure high availability andresponsiveness.
RequiredSkills & Qualifications
Education:
o Bachelors or Masters degree in ComputerScience, Engineering, or a related technical field.
Programming& Tools:
o Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Node.js.
o Expertise in SQL (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL(MongoDB).
o Experience with FastAPI, REST API design, andAPI documentation tools (e.g., swagger).
o Familiarity with SQLAlchemy, Pandas, NumPy, andtime-series databases.
Familiaritywith Docker, Kubernetes, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
Stronganalytical thinking, problem-solving ability, and attention to detail.
Excellentcommunication and collaboration skills.
Abilityto work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
Good-to-Have
AI/MLFrameworks:
o Experience with Agentic RAG pipelines,LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Hugging Face Transformers.
o Knowledge of Pandas, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow,or Keras for deep learning models.
o Integrate AI/ML models into backend systems,including LLMs, Generative AI, and NLP pipelines.
Experiencewith AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
Experiencewith ElasticSearch for search and analytics.
Unittesting, integration testing, and familiarity with frameworks like PyTest orJUnit.
Monitoring& Logging: Knowledge of tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK stack
Experiencewith ETL pipelines and data preprocessing
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and FastAPI experience, transferable AWS skills, but lacks MongoDB and container orchestration.
